product_version: Civil 3D extension; report dated Friday, Nov 21 2025

source.title: Channel Report, '18 INCH STORM DRAIN(PR-1A)', Circular, in Drainage study for Junipero Serra Museum ADA Improvements (CEQAnet 334972-1)

assumptions: Tolerance per output = half its printed digit + its change when the slope moves by the 0.005 % hidden by the report's 0.01 % slope precision (computed on the exact solution). n-values are taken as typed exactly as printed.
depth_step 0.01 ft reproduces Express's reporting of iterated depths rounded up to the next 0.01 ft (critical depth always; known-Q normal depth for Manning sections, not gutters).
No total depth is printed for a circular section; the diameter limits the depth.

Only critical depth is gated. Express's flow for this shape is not reproduced: at the depth its printed area and velocity imply, Pro-Flow's flow (Manning for pipes, the manual's gutter equation for gutters) is 0.6 to 6 % higher than the report's Q, not a constant factor and not explained by the documented equations. Depths are reported exact (printed = nearest 0.01 of the implied depth); critical depth rounded up, as for every shape.
